Admission Application Deadlines
This section provides information on the admission application deadlines for your applicant profile.
“Deadline” indicates the last date for submitting an application. Deadlines are strictly enforced for limited enrolment programs and limited space programs.
The dates listed on this webpage are for reference only. The deadline specified in the program description prevails, if applicable.
Please note that the choice of courses and programs is more limited for late admissions.

Please note that the administrative and immigration procedures for international applicants to study in Canada can take from 4 to 6 months. Except in specific situations, all admission applications received after the deadline will be postponed to a later semester.
The admission period runs until April 1 for certain doctorate programs and master’s programs with thesis. For more information, please contact the faculty academic advising team for your intended program of study.
Exceptionally, French and French-speaking Belgian students have until April 1, 2026, to apply for the Fall 2026 semester. Please consult the procedure for more information.

Supporting documents for your application
You must provide the supporting documents for your application in digital format when you submit your admission application online.
You can apply for admission even if you have not collected all the required documents yet. Make sure to send the requested documents before the deadline indicated in your online admission file. Otherwise your admission application could be refused.
